title: International ATM withdrawals for Blue Account
summary: For Blue Account debit card international ATM withdrawals in foreign currency, the fee is 3% of the withdrawal’s U.S. dollar equivalent, with a $5.00 minimum per transaction. International and domestic ATM withdrawals share a $500 daily limit across a 24-hour period, and the fee posts upon settlement as a separate line item; third-party ATM fees may also apply.
